content:
Together #42912 and #42693 prove that the Polish subspaces of a Polish space are exactly the Gδ subsets of that space. In descriptive set theory this characterization is sometimes called Alexandrov's theorem in descriptive set theory

Seems to fit into mathlib given that e.g. #42693 is a strengthening of IsOpen.polishSpace already in Mathlib/Topology/MetricSpace/Polish.lean

Both have gotten a few comments already with no outstanding issues, but have gone silent for a few weeks so figure I'd make a polite call for feedback in zulip. Thanks! :)
